notes.title: Mediterranean VR - ROADMAP 2023
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! 
First I would like to thank each and every one of you for the great support in the first steps of the development. Soon a small video of the first km of map created.
For now I just want to share with you the first phase of development via a Roadmap to let you know what awaits us in the year 2023. These are very important steps in development, the Kickstarter campaign in September is a fundamental step and your support in sharing as much as possible the game with anyone; sharing is one of the most important steps for game development!
See you soon Soldiers Survivors!
